ash: Following up from yesterday's DR postmortem. Creating a single-thread for owners on runbook fixes, backup verification, and the next regional game-day. Please claim items and set due timestamps.

ash: Items I pulled out: (A) missing step for partial table restore in runbook, (B) test plan for cross-region backup replication, (C) routing canary sequence + cooling lock, (D) game-day comms + incident roles.

mina: I'll take (A) partial table restore. I'll add exact pg_restore flags, an example transaction flow, and a timing estimate. Will include a small checklist: stop writes -> snapshot -> restore -> promote. ETA: 1817060000.

jorge: I'll own (B) backup replication tests. Plan: weekly job that restores a subset to a read-only namespace and runs a checksum diff; store artifacts in a locked bucket. Need to confirm CRR for ap-northeast-1. ETA: 1817080000.

infra-bot: backup-checker last_full=1816960000 last_inc=1816970000 status=ok replication_lag_seconds=42

ash: Good. @jorge please add masking rules for PII in the restore flow and coordinate with security-bot.

security-bot: Note: any production snapshot used for staging must be scrubbed. Provide scrub script in PR and request a security review. We can issue scoped creds for the pipeline once reviewed.

mina: For the partial-table runbook I'll include a sample command: `pg_restore --data-only -t customers -d staging_db -j 4 --no-owner` and a note about FK constraints ordering.

jorge: For automation I'll add a Prometheus metric `backup_validation_failures_total` and an alert if >0 for 1h. Also will upload validation report to s3://redwood-artifacts/dr-validate/.

ash: On routing: propose a canary sequence of 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 2-minute observation windows, plus a cooling lock of 10 minutes to prevent flapping. Who wants routing playbook ownership?

mina: I can draft the smoke test for endpoints and add `curl -fsS` checks to the playbook but won't own the BGP steps.

jorge: I can pair with infra for the routing steps during the game-day.

ash: Game-day volunteers: DB ops (mina), backups (jorge), routing (infra team), comms (I'll coordinate with product). Tentative date: 1817140000. I'll send invites.

infra-bot: scheduled_job: backup-dry-run next_run=1817083600

mina: ACK owning "partial table restore runbook" due_ts=1817060000

jorge: ACK owning "backup replication test + automation" due_ts=1817080000

ash: Tracker created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/dr-playbook-ownership-2026  comment on your row to accept. I'll mark rows in tracker as "assigned" once you confirm.

security-bot: Reminder: enable MFA-delete on artifact bucket and limit retention for validation artifacts to 90 days.

mina: small blocker  need CI runner roles to run a test restore. @security-bot can you approve short-lived creds once PR is up?

security-bot: Will approve after PR + scrub script.

ash: Great work. Please update the tracker when PRs are opened and add reviewers. Reopen thread if ownership changes. :white_check_mark:
